rules.name: Connection failed
rules.description: CMD_START_CONNECT without an IP configuration within 10 s (same netId)

rules.name: Association rejected
rules.description: The access point refused the station

rules.name: P2P state flapping
rules.description: 5 state changes of SemWifiP2pService within 5 s

rules.name: Scan stuck
rules.description: The scan state machine did not come back to IDLE within 5 s

rules.name: Scan timeout then abort
rules.description: The firmware did not answer a scan and the driver aborted it

rules.name: No wake up from deep sleep
rules.description: The chip entered deep sleep and did not wake up within 6 s

rules.name: Chip reset
rules.description: The firmware watchdog reset the chip

rules.name: TX paused too long
rules.description: The queues of a station paused for more than 1 s (same reason)

rules.name: Wall clock set
rules.description: Wall clock times before and after this line can not be compared (the time since boot can)
